arxiv-2003-01206.title: A Scalar-Parameterized Mechanism For Two-Sided Markets
arxiv-2003-01206.creator: Mariola Ndrio, Khaled Alshehri, Subhonmesh Bose
arxiv-2003-01206.description: Abstract We consider a market in which both suppliers and consumers compete for a product via scalar-parameterized supply offers and demand bids. Scalar-parameterized offers/bids are appealing due to their modeling simplicity and desirable mathematical properties with the most prominent being bounded efficiency loss and price markup under strategic interactions. Our model incorporates production capacity constraints and minimum inelastic demand requirements.

arxiv-2208-09078.title: Gaussian Basis Functions for a Polymer Self-Consistent Field Theory of Atoms
arxiv-2208-09078.creator: Phil A. LeMaitre, Russell B. Thompson
arxiv-2208-09078.description: Abstract A representation of polymer self-consistent field theory equivalent to quantum density functional theory is given in terms of non-orthogonal basis sets. Molecular integrals and self-consistent equations for spherically symmetric systems using Gaussian basis functions are given, and the binding energies and radial electron densities of neutral atoms hydrogen through krypton are calculated.

arxiv-2211-04871.title: Graph classes equivalent to 12-representable graphs
arxiv-2211-04871.creator: Asahi Takaoka
arxiv-2211-04871.description: Abstract . Jones et al. (2015) introduced the notion of u u -representable graphs, where u u is a word over { 1 , 2 } \{1,2\} different from 22 ⋯ 2 22\cdots 2 , as a generalization of word-representable graphs.

arxiv-2309-05654.title: Amalgame: Cosmological Constraints from the First Combined Photometric Supernova Sample
arxiv-2309-05654.creator: Brodie Popovic, Daniel Scolnic, Maria Vincenzi, Mark Sullivan, Dillon Brout, Bruno O. Sanchez, Rebecca Chen, Utsav Patel, Erik R. Peterson, Richard Kessler, Lisa Kelsey, Ava Claire Bailey, Phil Wiseman, Marcus Toy
arxiv-2309-05654.description: Abstract Future constraints of cosmological parameters from Type Ia supernovae (SNe Ia) will depend on the use of photometric samples, those samples without spectroscopic measurements of the SNe Ia. There is a growing number of analyses that show that photometric samples can be utilised for precision cosmological studies with minimal systematic uncertainties.

arxiv-2405-08140.title: Entropy numbers of Reproducing Hilbert Space of zonal positive definite kernels on compact two-point homogeneous spaces
arxiv-2405-08140.creator: Karina Gonzalez & Thaís Jordão
arxiv-2405-08140.description: Abstract Abstract: We present estimates for the covering numbers of the unit ball of Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces (RKHSs) of functions on \mathbb{M}^{d} a d -dimensional compact two-point homogeneous space. The RKHS is generated by a continuous zonal/isotropic positive definite kernel.

arxiv-2405-14369.title: RoPINN: Region Optimized Physics-Informed Neural Networks
arxiv-2405-14369.creator: Haixu Wu, Huakun Luo, Yuezhou Ma, Jianmin Wang, Mingsheng LongSchool of Software, BNRist, Tsinghua University, China {wuhx23,luohk19,mayz20}@mails.tsinghua.edu.cn , {jimwang,mingsheng}@tsinghua.edu.cn
arxiv-2405-14369.description: Abstract Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have been widely applied to solve partial differential equations (PDEs) by enforcing outputs and gradients of deep models to satisfy target equations. Due to the limitation of numerical computation, PINNs are conventionally optimized on finite selected points.

arxiv-2407-05493.title: Conventional s − s- wave superconductivity and hidden peak effect in single crystals of Mo 8 Ga 41 superconductor
arxiv-2407-05493.creator: Sunil Ghimire, Kyuil Cho, Kamal R. Joshi, Makariy A. Tanatar, Zhixiang Hu, Cedomir Petrovic, Ruslan Prozorov
arxiv-2407-05493.description: Abstract London and Campbell penetration depths were measured in single crystals of the endohedral gallide cluster superconductor, Mo 8 Ga 41 . The full temperature range superfluid density is consistent with the clean isotropic s − s- wave weak-coupling BCS theory without any signs of the second gap or strong coupling.

arxiv-2410-20535.title: Asynchronous Perception Machine for Test Time Training
arxiv-2410-20535.creator: Rajat Modi, Yogesh Singh Rawat
arxiv-2410-20535.description: Abstract In this work, we propose Asynchronous Perception Machine (APM), a computationally-efficient architecture for test-time-training (TTT). APM can process patches of an image one at a time in any order asymmetrically, and still encode semantic-awareness in the net. We demonstrate APM’s ability to recognize out-of-distribution images without dataset-specific pre-training, augmentation or any-pretext task.

arxiv-2512-05065.title: Personalizing Agent Privacy Decisions via Logical Entailment Volume: YYYY X DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX
arxiv-2512-05065.creator: James Flemings, Ren Yi, Octavian Suciu, Kassem Fawaz, Murali Annavaram, Marco Gruteser
arxiv-2512-05065.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by James Flemings, Ren Yi, Octavian Suciu, Kassem Fawaz, Murali Annavaram, Marco Gruteser. Personal language model-based agents are becoming more widespread for completing tasks on behalf of users; however, this raises serious privacy questions regarding whether these models will appropriately disclose user data. While prior work has evaluated language models on data-sharing scenarios based on general privacy norms, we focus on personalizing language models’ privacy decisions, grounding their judgments directly in prior user privacy decisions.

pmc-11521854.title: Flavonoids against depression: a comprehensive review of literature
pmc-11521854.creator: Alaleh Alizadeh, Yeganeh Pourfallah-Taft, Maryam Khoshnazar, Aysan Safdari, Saba Vafadar Komari, Mehrnaz Zanganeh, Nafiseh Sami, Maryam Valizadeh, Arezoo Faridzadeh, Dorsa Alijanzadeh, Seyed Amirhossein Mazhari, Reza Khademi, Ali Kheirandish, Mahdyieh Naziri
pmc-11521854.description: BackgroundDepression is a state of low mood and aversion to activity, which affects a person’s thoughts, behavior, motivation, feelings, and sense of wellbeing. Pharmacologic therapies are still the best effective treatment of depression. Still, most antidepressant drugs have low efficacy and delayed onset of therapeutic action, have different side effects, and even exacerbate depression.

pmc-12644989.title: Optimization of primary culture, inflammatory induction, and molecular analysis of fibroblast-like synoviocytes in a rat model of osteoarthritis pain
pmc-12644989.creator: Ao Xiong, Zhaoxin Ma, Renping Xiong, Fei Luo
pmc-12644989.description: Synovitis, driven by fibroblast-like synoviocytes (FLS), is a key early event in knee osteoarthritis (KOA). The lack of standardized protocols for FLS culture and molecular analysis hinders reproducible in vitro modeling of early KOA. We developed an integrated platform combining MIA-induced KOA pain modeling, standardized primary FLS culture, inflammation induction, and molecular analysis.

pmc-12702607.title: The Barthel Index Scale as an Indicator of Nursing Workload
pmc-12702607.creator: Savvato Karavasileiadou, Antigoni Fountouki, Christos Savopoulos, Hanan Alyami, Hanan HamdanAlshehri, Dimitrios Theofanidis
pmc-12702607.description: BackgroundThe Barthel Index (BI) is a standardized tool used to evaluate patients’ ability to perform daily activities. Lower scores on the index indicate greater dependency. The distribution of nursing workload is often uneven and rarely assessed using validated measures, particularly on busy days, such as those following patient admission days when care demands are higher.

pmc-12722919.title: The impact of traditional mind–body exercises on pulmonary function, exercise capacity, and quality of life in patients with lung cancer: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12722919.creator: Mingqi Wu, Sidi Zhang, Hongka Zhang, Yijun Yin, Shiyun Wang, Weiwei Li, Jing Xiao, Zhanying Tang
pmc-12722919.description: BackgroundA systematic evaluation of the clinical effects of mind-body traditional Chinese exercises (Qigong, Taichi, Baduanjin, Liuzijue and Wuqinxi) lung cancer patients.MethodsSystematic searches of PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library, Web of Science and China Knowledge Network (CNKI), Wan fang, China Biology Medicine disc (CBM), and VIP were performed from the time of library construction to August 20, 2025.

pmc-13325577.title: Development and validation of a nomogram model for predicting negative/indeterminate HIV-1 antibody confirmation: a strategy to streamline the diagnostic pathway
pmc-13325577.creator: Guijuan Liao, Shaocheng Zhang, Yi Wei, Yu Jin, Xiaoling Liu, Hui Quan, Huanhuan Wang
pmc-13325577.description: BackgroundThe standard HIV diagnostic algorithm comprises sequential serological screening, confirmatory antibody testing, and nucleic acid confirmation when necessary. This multi-step process often causes diagnostic delays, particularly in cases with indeterminate or discordant results. Developing a Nomogram-based predictive tool to identify individuals at high risk of anti-HIV-1 negative or inconclusive antibody confirmation could significantly optimize testing efficiency.

pmc-13416497.title: Does apical vertebra location influence the final outcome of bracing for idiopathic scoliosis?
pmc-13416497.creator: Angelo G. AULISA, Martina MARSIOLO, Marco GIORDANO, Diletta BANDINELLI, Luca BASIGLINI, Francesco FALCIGLIA
pmc-13416497.description: BACKGROUNDIdiopathic scoliosis represents a complex spinal alteration characterized by lateral curvature and rotation of the spine. Among the numerous factors influencing treatment response, the role of the apical vertebra in idiopathic scoliosis remains a topic of significant interest and debate.

pmc-13539800.title: Differential metabolites and key pathways in quinoa rhizosphere responding to salt stress: implications for salt tolerance
pmc-13539800.creator: Jiaqi Gu, Yuanru Yang, Haiying Guo, Yiran Zhao, Yu Chun, Sarina Bao
pmc-13539800.description: BackgroundAs an important salt-alkali-tolerant crop, quinoa can respond to salt stress through various pathways. However, the response mechanisms of the rhizosphere microenvironment to salt stress require further exploration. This study aimed to investigate the effects of salt stress on the metabolic profile of quinoa rhizosphere soil and to explore its salt tolerance mechanisms at the metabolic level.

pmc-13561337.title: Shifting social norms, behavioural intentions and opposition to female genital mutilation: Effectiveness of layered community interventions in a high prevalence setting in Kenya
pmc-13561337.creator: Dennis Juma Matanda, Martina Mchenga, Stella Muthuri, Francis Obare, Teresa Awili, Zamzam Hassan, Chi-Chi Undie, Johanna Pruller, Laura Asher
pmc-13561337.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Female genital mutilation (FGM) remains prevalent in parts of Kenya, sustained by social norms around marriageability and social belonging. Although community interventions to end FGM are widely implemented, quantitative evidence of their effectiveness remains limited. This study evaluated whether mixed-sex community dialogues and women-only reflection circles implemented through the Girl Generation-Africa-Led Movement Programme changed FGM-related beliefs, intentions, social norms, and opposition to FGM in Isiolo County, Kenya.

pmc-13577253.title: Benchmarking three simple DNA staining-based image metrics for live-cell tracking of chromatin organization
pmc-13577253.creator: Minwoo Kang, Aidan Tomas Cabral, Manasi Sawant, Hawa Racine Thiam
pmc-13577253.description: Quantifying chromatin-state dynamics in living cells remains challenging, in part because most methods require fixation or cell lysis. Here, we introduce two simple DNA image-derived metrics - Diffuse Signal Index (DSI)and 1-Gini - and benchmark them against the coefficient of variation (CV) as fixation-free readouts of chromatin reorganization.
